build_runtime_params: build runtime parameters from InternalBoundaryConditionsConfig at a given time for ion and electron profiles
merge_internal_boundary_conditions: merge two InternalBoundaryConditions objects with non-zero values from the second taking precedence
apply_adaptive_source: apply adaptive source terms to enforce internal boundary conditions on temperature and density profiles
create_internal_boundary_conditions: create an InternalBoundaryConditions object with ion temperature, electron temperature, and electron density arrays
validate_config_from_dict: validate an InternalBoundaryConditionsConfig from a dictionary with sparse time-varying array definitions
